name: Sign out
description: Signing out is a revocation, not just a cookie clear: the token names a row in `sessions` through its `sid` claim and every authed statement joins live_sessions, so marking the row revoked ends the token before its 30-day `exp`. The cookie is still cleared, because the browser has no other reason to stop sending it. Idempotent by the `revoked_at IS NULL` predicate. The clearing cookie's `secure` attribute must match the one that set it, so it reads the same cookie_secure var.

input.query: UPDATE sessions SET revoked_at = now() WHERE sid = ($1)::uuid AND revoked_at IS NULL

tasks.name: Drop the session entry
tasks.description: Sign-out's tombstone is a delete: the entry that answered /v1/me for this session goes with the row. Not continue_on_error -- a sign-out the cache did not record would keep answering for five minutes, so the request fails and the person signs out again.
